summary: Space Mission Designer – RAPSODI is an interactive educational game that allows users to experience the challenges of planning and managing a space mission. Players take the role of mission directors and design their own missions by selecting spacecraft components, scientific instruments, launch vehicles, and orbital destinations. They must manage limited resources such as budget, fuel, power, and spacecraft mass while making critical engineering decisions. The simulation demonstrates how different design choices affect mission performance, risks, and overall success. By combining space science, engineering concepts, resource management, and interactive gameplay, the project makes complex space mission planning accessible and engaging for students. It aims to encourage scientific curiosity, problem-solving, and practical understanding of space technology.
details:
RAPSODI is designed as an interactive space mission planning and simulation platform. It allows participants to experience the complete process of designing and managing a space mission through an engaging game environment.

Users begin by selecting a mission objective and destination, followed by choosing a launch vehicle, spacecraft structure, scientific instruments, and communication systems. Each component has different mass, power, and cost requirements.

The game introduces resource-management challenges involving budget, fuel, power consumption, payload capacity, and communication limitations. Players must balance these requirements to create an efficient mission design.

After completing the design, users can simulate different mission stages, including launch, orbital operations, spacecraft communication, and mission completion. The system evaluates the mission based on engineering decisions, resource utilization, and achievement of objectives.

The project aims to make aerospace engineering concepts easier to understand through practical experimentation, interactive learning, and decision-making.
